body:
English isn't my native language, so I apologize if there are some spelling or grammatical errors.
At the time of my trip I couldn't get any weed because the connections I had stopped selling and I read that "Moonlight" would be a good weed substitute if you want to chill. It is definitely not a weed substitute.
I rolled a joint from it (ratio 90/10 like I do with weed) and took a deep puff. Despite years of daily smoking, I never built up a tolerance to weed, so I should have definitely taken a much smaller dose. No, I should not haven taken it at all.
I was on Discord with a friend, and shortly after inhaling, I immediately realized, 'This is not good.' I mumbled 'not good, not good' to myself, and my friend tried to reassure and lighten the mood by making some jokes, but it only overwhelmed me more. It felt like everything was rushing into my head more and more and it was already way too much but it just kept going.
It felt like my body was heating up from the inside, as if I had goosebumps on my bones.
It felt like my body was heating up from the inside, as if I had goosebumps on my bones.
My screen started flickering white before my eyes, and I told my friend on Discord that I needed to lie down for a moment. From there, I'm not exactly sure what happened, so to make it a bit more organized I will tell you what was going on for me and then what my friend told me he heard over Discord.
In my head, I was completely gone. I don't know how it started, but suddenly, I heard thousands of voices but couldn't make out what they were saying. I heard something on the left and something on the right, and eventually, it was three sentences (? - as I said, it sounded like gibberish) that kept repeating on the left and right. One "sentence" sounded like it came out of a TV of a comedian telling a joke and the crowd laughing. another one sounded like it came from Discord (that COULD have been my friend, but it was always the same sentence and it was always gibberish for me but the sound of it was like if it came from Discord).
At some point, I thought, 'Fuck, I've destroyed my brain.'  I had lost all sense of time. How long had I been like this? What day is it today? Where am I right now? Am I at work? Did someone just say something? Should I smile? Should I say something? I couldn't see shit. Everything was black but I had a feeling I was somewhere doing something and I was shitting myself thinking I've literally gone crazy and I tried my best to hide it.
I remember that I forgot what things were. Literally things. Like chairs, buildings, everything - and I mean EVERYTHING.
I remember thousand shapes flashing in front of me - but with no colour. Imagine it like seeing thousands of colours but on a back and white TV? I don't know how to describe it but it rushed through my brain and it got more and more intense until it suddenly stopped.
Eventually, I started to panic, my head turned to the left - "It has been weeks, you will stay like this forever, you fucked your brain, you destroyed your life" - and I breathed faster and faster. Then I calmed myself down, 'no, no, I just took a hit a few minutes ago, everything will be fine. It's just still the same trip, it hasn't been long' - my head turned to the right, and I breathed more relaxed. It went on like this for what seemed like forever. Back and forth. Panicking, relaxing.
I'm trying to mention everything here as best as possible, but it felt like 10,000 things were going on in my head at once.  During the back and forth in and with my head (I always moved it to the left or right), there was intermittent intense retching - I couldn't breathe and it hurt like hell, it scared me. I thought I was lying on some stone floor in the middle of nowhere.
After that I thought I realized something. I felt like a big baby head with a tiny body. I thought I was at a place that is nothing. And next to me were other creatures like me. I thought 'THIS is existence'. The whole world, the whole universe was just my imagination. I thought the panic and the pain I just felt were always there. I thought that that was real life. I thought I was only dreaming and making up the whole world, the whole universe and my existence and that it was just my way to cope with the dread, the pain and the terror of the real experience of life. Which was being me - a big baby head with a tiny body - just suffering for all eternity. I thought the creatures next to me did the same. Imagining their own universes and lives while suffering.
Then, at some point, I thought I was simply dead. And lying in a coffin. I thought I had been dead for years. Decades. I had absolute panic and kept moving my arms in a circular motion, feeling the 'coffin' around me. It felt like I was doing this circular motion for an eternity. The panic increased and increased and almost became unbearable. But then I "realized" something yet again. I thought that I just have to accept that I'm dead and after that I would finally be free. I moved my arms in that circular motion faster and faster and I started to feel very...happy? Excited? I couldn't wait to finally let go.
And eventually, I accepted that I was dead. And let go.  I let go everything that troubled me. Everything that ever made me sad, depressed and traumatized. I swam in the midst of nothing. And I was nothing. It was absolutely peaceful. I never felt this peacful in my life, ever.
Then I opened my eyes. I was lying next to the sofa and saw my office chair. I was absolutely confused and overwhelmed. It looked so... real? As I mentioned, I had lost all sense of real things. But this. This was so real, so detailed. So focused. I closed my eyes again, but after a few seconds, I had a bit more consciousness again, and I knew at least what had brought me to the floor. Moonlight.
I got up and went to the PC. I looked at the clock. It was 6:39 PM. I stared at the time and couldn't make anything of it. To put it in context, the 'trip' lasted about 20 minutes.
I was completely messed up. My friend was still on Discord, and when he noticed that I was back to consciousness, he immediately told me that he had called an ambulance and it should be there soon. They arrived, and I went with them. My head was still full of strange, overwhelming thoughts. As if my head was about 5 seconds ahead of the entire reality. As if I had thoughts before I had thoughts. After about 3 hours, I was somewhat back to normal.
After about 3 hours, I was somewhat back to normal.
Now my friend on discord said that after I said that I need to lay down I actually managed to lay down on my sofa. But a few seconds later I started to have convulsions (he said he instantly recognized the sound as he heard it a million times watching snuff videos) and it also sounded like I was vomitting over and over again the entire time. He also mentioned that he heard me saying something but it appeared to just be gibberish.
Now for the vomitting part - when I came back from the hospital I didn't find a single drop of vomit so I guess I nearly suffocated in my own vomit that night.
This was almost 4 months ago, and since then, I've been completely clean and sober. No weed, no alcohol, nothing at all. Nothing that could mess with my head in any way. Fuck drugs, this was my wake-up-call.
